state.case_summary:
An individual around 60 years old living in a rural area in the southeastern US was hospitalized with altered mental status, fever, flaccid paralysis of all extremities, and respiratory failure with lower lobe nodules and a left lower lobe infiltrate. Medical history included porphyria with polyneuropathy, alcohol use disorder, and a recent diagnosis of hyper-IgE syndrome, for which they received oral prednisone before admission.

Patient presented with:- Altered mental status- Fever- Flaccid paralysis of all extremities- Respiratory distress

{'Laboratory Tests': 'Bronchoalveolar lavage revealed:- Aspergillus fumigatus- Candida spp- Pseudomonas aeruginosa', 'Pathological Findings': 'Autopsy findings:- Disseminated aspergillosis and candidiasis without ocular involvement- Multiple organ involvement including lungs, liver, pancreas, colon, appendix, and kidneys- Inflammatory infiltrates with lymphocytes, plasma cells, macrophages, and numerous eosinophils- Right eye: focal eosinophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate in posterior choroid with larval sections- Left eye: focal eosinophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate in posteronasal choroid', 'Imaging Studies': {'Image 1': {'Title': 'Posterotemporal Choroid of the Right Eye', 'Description': 'Focal eosinophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate with a cross-section of a possible degenerating larva'}, 'Image 2': {'Title': 'Posteronasal Choroid of the Right Eye', 'Description': 'Coiled, incompletely sectioned filariform larva within a medium-caliber artery'}}}
